# Expected results taken from another architecture's run instead of the
# architecture's own, read by record-expected.sh after recording.
#
# The Docker host runs non-native architectures through binfmt_misc. When the
# handler is QEMU user mode, system calls are emulated by QEMU rather than
# serviced by the kernel, and QEMU's emulation diverges from Linux for some
# calls. A case belongs here only when every checked behavior comes from
# architecture-independent kernel code, so a real kernel of any architecture
# is a faithful oracle for it; the reason column names that code and the
# divergence. The per-architecture unit tests in
# src/user/linux/tests/syscall_mm.rs cover the same semantics independently.
#
# Columns: architecture  case  source-architecture  reason...
riscv64  mman  aarch64  mm/madvise.c and mm/mprotect.c are generic; QEMU 'target_madvise' ignores most advice and QEMU validates mprotect's prot before its length
